description: Fetch a Google Docs document's title and plain-text body content. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the title + body arrive via a follow-up message once the fetch completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch a Google Docs document by id as a background job and return its title plus a plain-text body assembled from paragraph text runs. Use this lightweight read to inspect or summarize document wording before editing. Tables, images, and rendered layout are available through the document export path.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the document read; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to fetch a Google Docs document's content.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the document id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_found: verify the document id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
